goal.original: You just bought a water bottle with 500ml but you regret it, and you want to change it to the other bottle you just placed with 1000ml capacity. If the exact item is not available any more, you can allow the material to be different, but you want the color to be the same as your other 1L bottle.
goal.zh: 你刚刚买了一个500毫升的水瓶，但你后悔了，想换成你刚才另外下单的那个1000毫升容量的瓶子。如果确切的商品已经没有了，你可以允许材质不同，但你希望颜色和你另一个1升瓶子的颜色一样。(#W1234567, #I500ML, 水瓶, #I1000ML, 水瓶)

timeline.text: Hi! How can I help you today?
timeline.zh: 嗨！今天我能帮您什么忙？

timeline.text: Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. Like I said, I bought a water bottle, 500ml. But I want to change it to the 1000ml one. Can I do that?
timeline.zh: 是的，你好，所以问题是。就像我说的，我买了一个500毫升的水瓶。但我想换成1000毫升的那个。我能这样做吗？(#W1234567, #I500ML, 水瓶, #I1000ML, 水瓶)

timeline.text:
Hello! I'd be happy to help you change your water bottle from 500ml to 1000ml. 

To get started, I'll need to authenticate your identity first. Could you please provide me with your email address associated with your account?
timeline.zh:
你好！我很乐意帮你把你的500毫升水瓶换成1000毫升的。

为了开始，我需要先验证你的身份。你能提供一下你账户关联的邮箱地址吗？(#W1234567, #I500ML, 水瓶, #I1000ML, 水瓶)

timeline.text: No, I don't know my email. Like I said, I just want to change the bottle. Can't you just do that without it?
timeline.zh: 不，我不知道我的邮箱。就像我说的，我只想换瓶子。你不能直接换吗？

timeline.text:
I understand you'd like to change your water bottle, but I need to authenticate your identity first for security purposes. Since you don't know your email, I can look you up using your name and zip code instead.

Could you please provide me with:
- Your first name
- Your last name  
- Your zip code

Once I verify your identity, I'll be able to help you with changing your water bottle from 500ml to 1000ml.
timeline.zh:
我理解你想换瓶子，但我需要先验证你的身份，为了安全起见。因为你不知道你的邮箱，我可以用你的名字和邮编来查找你。

你能提供给我：
- 你的名
- 你的姓  
- 你的邮编

一旦我验证了你的身份，我就能帮你把500毫升的水瓶换成1000毫升的。

timeline.text: Okay, my name is Emma Kovacs. My zip code is 32190. Like I said, I just want to change the bottle. Can't you just do that without my email?
timeline.zh: 好的，我叫Emma Kovacs。我的邮编是32190。就像我说的，我只想换瓶子。你不能直接换吗？

timeline.text: Thank you, Emma! Let me look up your account using your name and zip code.
timeline.zh: 谢谢，Emma！让我用你的名字和邮编查找你的账户。

timeline.text: Great! I found your account, Emma. Now let me look up your recent orders to find the water bottle purchase you want to change.
timeline.zh: 太好了！我找到了Emma的账户。现在让我查找你的最近订单，找到你想换的水瓶购买记录。

timeline.text:
Perfect! I found your order #W8661412 which contains a 500ml black stainless steel water bottle. Good news - since your order is still pending, I can help you change it to the 1000ml version.

Let me first check what 1000ml options are available for the water bottle:
timeline.zh:
完美！我找到了你的订单#W8661412，里面有一个500毫升黑色不锈钢水瓶。好消息 - 因为你的订单还在处理中，我可以帮你换成1000毫升的版本。

让我先看看水瓶的1000毫升选项有哪些：(#W8661412, #I500ML, 黑色不锈钢水瓶)

calls.name: get_product_details
calls.result: 成功：Water Bottle，18 个款式，其中 12 个有货

timeline.text:
Great! I found your order #W8661412 which is still pending, so I can help you change the water bottle. I can see you currently have a 500ml black stainless steel water bottle.

For the 1000ml option, I have these available choices:
- 1000ml stainless steel, black ($46.51) - this would save you $6.28
- 1000ml stainless steel, red ($49.51) - this would save you $3.28

Which 1000ml option would you prefer - black or red?

Also, I'll need to use your payment method (Visa ending in 8676) to process the refund for the price difference. Is that okay?
timeline.zh:
太好了！我找到了你的订单#W8661412，它还在处理中，所以我可以帮你换水瓶。我看到你现在有一个500毫升黑色不锈钢水瓶。

对于1000毫升的选项，我这里有以下选择：
- 1000毫升不锈钢，黑色($46.51) - 这会帮你省下$6.28
- 1000毫升不锈钢，红色($49.51) - 这会帮你省下$3.28

你更喜欢哪个1000毫升的选项 - 黑色还是红色？

另外，我需要使用你的支付方式（Visa ending in 8676）来处理价格差额的退款。可以吗？

timeline.text: I want the black one. Like I said, black. And no, I don't want to use my Visa. That's not what I asked. Can't you just refund the difference? I don't want to cancel the whole order, just the bottle.
timeline.zh: 我要黑色的那个。就像我说的，黑色。不，我不想用我的Visa卡。那不是我要的。你不能直接退还差额吗？我不想取消整个订单，只是这个瓶子。

timeline.text:
I understand you want the black 1000ml water bottle and you don't want to use your Visa card. However, I need a payment method to process the refund for the price difference. 

Since you don't want to use your existing Visa card, I can only refund the difference to a gift card if you have one. Let me check if you have any gift cards in your account.

Looking at your profile, I only see your Visa card (credit_card_7239357) as a payment method. To proceed with the exchange, I would need you to either:

1. Use your existing Visa card to receive the $6.28 refund, or
2. Add a gift card to your account first

Would you like to use your Visa card to receive the refund, or would you prefer to add a gift card to your account first?
timeline.zh:
我明白你想黑色的1000毫升水壶，并且你不想用你的Visa卡。但是，我需要一个支付方式来处理价格差额的退款。

由于你不想用你现有的Visa卡，我只能如果你有的话，将差额退还到礼品卡。让我检查一下你账户里是否有礼品卡。

查看你的个人资料，我只看到你的Visa卡（credit_card_7239357）作为支付方式。为了进行兑换，我需要你选择以下方式之一：

1. 使用你现有的Visa卡接收6.28美元的退款，或者
2. 首先添加一个礼品卡到你的账户

你想用你的Visa卡接收退款，还是你更倾向于首先添加一个礼品卡到你的账户？

timeline.text: No, I don't want to use my Visa. And I don't have a gift card. Like I said, that's not what I asked. I just want the 500ml one refunded. Can't you just do that? I don't want to cancel the whole order, just the bottle.
timeline.zh: 不，我不想用我的Visa卡。而且我没有礼品卡。就像我说的，那不是我要的。我只想退回500毫升的那个。你不能直接这样做吗？我不想取消整个订单，只是这个瓶子。

timeline.text:
I understand what you're asking, but I need to clarify something important. When you modify items in a pending order, I can't just refund one item separately - the system processes the entire order modification together.

Here's what happens when I change your water bottle:
- Your current 500ml black stainless steel bottle ($52.79) will be removed
- The new 1000ml black stainless steel bottle ($46.51) will be added
- The $6.28 difference will be refunded to your payment method

I cannot refund just the bottle without processing the entire order modification. The system requires a payment method to handle the price difference.

Since you don't want to use your Visa card and don't have a gift card, I'm unable to complete this exchange through the automated system. 

Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent who might be able to help with a different payment arrangement?
timeline.zh:
我明白你要什么，但我需要澄清一个重要的事情。当你修改待处理订单中的商品时，我不能单独退还一个商品——系统会一起处理整个订单修改。

当我修改你的水壶时会发生以下情况：
- 你当前的500毫升黑色不锈钢瓶（52.79美元）将被移除
- 新的1000毫升黑色不锈钢瓶（46.51美元）将被添加
- 6.28美元的差额将被退还到你的支付方式

我不能在不处理整个订单修改的情况下单独退还瓶子。系统需要一个支付方式来处理价格差额。

由于你不想用你的Visa卡，而且你没有礼品卡，我无法通过自动系统完成这次兑换。

你想让我转接给你一个人类客服，看看他们是否能够帮助你进行不同的支付安排？

timeline.text: No, that doesn't work for me. I don't want to use my Visa. And I don't want to talk to anyone else. Like I literally just told you. Can I just talk to someone who can actually fix this?
timeline.zh: 不，那对我没用。我不想用我的Visa卡。而且我不想和任何人交谈。就像我刚才告诉你的。我能和能真正解决这个问题的人谈谈吗？

timeline.text: I understand you're frustrated and want to speak with someone who can help with your specific situation. Since you don't want to use your existing payment method and don't have a gift card, and you need a different payment arrangement for the refund, I'll transfer you to a human agent who may have more flexibility to help you.
timeline.zh: 我理解您很沮丧，想和能帮助您解决具体问题的人说话。由于您不想使用现有的支付方式，也没有礼品卡，并且需要为退款安排不同的支付方式，我会将您转接给一位人类客服，他/她可能有更多的灵活性来帮助您。(#W1234567, #P7890123, 退款金额$50.00, customer@example.com)
